references.label: Earth sea level
caveats: Microgravity only: PSI has no partial-gravity combustion data.
Burn duration of a laboratory spherical gas flame, not the time available to respond to a fire.
Tad and Zst are calculated (chemical equilibrium), not measured.

gravity_effect.note: No combustion data exist in partial or normal gravity in PSI. Buoyancy carries products away and brings fresh oxidizer; it is expected to weaken the radiative self-extinction seen in microgravity, so the microgravity duration is likely a LOWER bound on persistence (docs/04_physics/PARTIAL_GRAVITY_BOUNDING.md).
